I've already got the image, so now I'm turning it into structured output. It's a Korean delivery note from Hwaseong Memory Co., Ltd. to Soony Distribution Center in Hamburg, dated 2026.08.21, covering two purchase orders and two lines of CMP-GAM-002.

Now I'm checking the weight, box count and carrier, and noting that the remarks and receiver signature are blank. The per-box quantities look very uneven between the two lines, but that isn't a contradiction. Nothing on the document maps each PO to its line, and there's no receiving stamp. The 168 kg total looks plausible for 43,000 cards plus packaging.

verdict.summary_en: Korean delivery note DN-260821-169 dated 2026.08.21 from Hwaseong Memory Co., Ltd. to Soony Distribution Center Hamburg. It covers two lines of CMP-GAM-002 (Game Card 64 GB – Grand Heist 5): 21 000 PCS in 10 boxes and 22 000 PCS in 4 boxes. Totals are 14 boxes and 168 kg, shipped by Nordhav Shipping A/S. It references two POs, 4500318694 and 4500318701. There are no handwritten corrections or stamps. The receiver signature line is blank.
red_flags: Two POs (4500318694, 4500318701) are listed but the lines do not say which quantity belongs to which PO.
The same material CMP-GAM-002 appears on two separate lines (21 000 and 22 000 PCS). The note gives no combined total (43 000 PCS if the lines are added).
Box density differs sharply between the lines: 21 000 PCS in 10 boxes versus 22 000 PCS in 4 boxes.
The receiver (인수자) signature line is blank and there is no receiving stamp or date, so receipt is not confirmed on this document.
The note shows no unit prices and no ordered or confirmed quantities, so it cannot be checked against the POs from this document alone.
observations: The scan is slightly rotated but fully legible.
No handwriting, stamps or strike-throughs are visible.
The receiver signature line is empty.
A barcode is printed at the top right.
Quantities use a space as the thousands separator (21 000 = 21000).
